react-native.reason: RN core: WebSocket module and doc URLs; our code cannot call them (lint layer A)

whatwg-fetch.reason: fetch polyfill installed by RN; unused by our code

expo.reason: Expo winter fetch polyfill; unused by our code

@iabtcf/core.reason: TCF decoder used by react-native-google-mobile-ads (allowed component N3 a); its GVL download is not called

expo-iap.reason: kit-api.ts (IAPKit) is bundled through the index re-export but every entry point is banned (lint + audit)

expo-asset.reason: AssetSources.js builds Expo CDN URLs (classic-assets.eascdn.net) for assets served by a dev server or updates; Release builds embed every asset and our code passes no remote source (URL literals are lint-banned)

react-native-worklets.reason: docs.swmansion.com links inside error messages (debug/checkCppVersion.js, memory/serializable.native.js); no request is made

react-native-reanimated.reason: documentation links inside error and logger messages (common/logger.js, checkCppVersion.js, pluginUtils.js); no request is made

react-reconciler.reason: react.dev/errors decoder link inside production error messages; no request is made

react-native-audio-api.reason: AudioDecoder.decodeFromRemoteUrl fetches only when decodeAudioData gets an http(s) URL; our sound banks are synthesised in code and URL literals are lint-banned

@expo/devtools.reason: WebSocketWithReconnect.js is the dev-tools plugin client that expo re-exports; it connects only to a running dev server, which Release builds never have, and no Shell code calls it
